arguments.title: test: validate diagnostic, collaboration and Windows settlement repairs
arguments.body:
## Purpose

Validate the three published E2E repairs at fixed commit aab3d84ceb40674abb2139c6cc82a383c0b14df4 against the previously tested source commit 86f52244b5375834a4040cbc63803d68cc708087. The real seven-commit ancestor interval contains three source changes and 140 documentation changes.

## Changes

The native diagnostic test searches for publish-end after the selected publish call. Both collaboration comparisons expect the finite Claude catalog's resolved TEST model ID. The Windows Processes fixture waits for the selected completed stop record's separate native settlement, preserving its original ten-second deadline, capture/identity checks and final native assertions.

## Validation

Six existing executable workflow families select 18 Host Desktop lanes, four whole frontend shards, five Host process platforms, five packaged platforms, nine Stage 1 OpenCode jobs, announcements and CI fast feedback. CodeQL and Sentry retain their explicit Draft guards. Three other previously Draft-skipped families do not match this real source delta.

All original cases, filters, commands, deadlines and cleanup remain. Workflow edits are limited to two expected-model literals. Whole team-UI149, model-catalog43, provider-management85, settings11, captured-status7, native-UI8 and native-receipt12 plus whole-platform14 remain selected through their existing routes.

Claude and Codex use finite TEST peers only, including metadata/version paths. Actual OpenCode uses existing pinned localhost-model paths. No real Claude/Codex execution is permitted.

The existing Draft Full qualification failure is expected policy. Other failures, skipped/cancelled/unknown/unreached steps and uncertain cleanup remain non-PASS. Earlier Windows readiness/Retry, Claude target movement, V2 Settings, Darwin installer/P09 and other unresolved evidence are not promoted by these source changes.

Both snapshot refs and PR metadata stay fixed. Earlier CI and the completed standalone RED/GREEN attempts remain spent. No Ready, merge, release, default activation, Stage2 or broad native/vendor qualification.
